This helper is shown below the Budget remaining metric. Adding total makes the English phrase natural and clarifies the comparison denominator.

notes: All ten namespaces have 467 matching string leaves in each locale; every path and ICU placeholder name matches between Thai and English.
No Thai script appears in English strings. Thai strings use Latin text only for brand names, platform names, or keyboard shortcuts such as Enter and Shift+Enter.

Quick Capture uses distinct labels for Task/งาน, Event/เหตุการณ์, Note/โน้ต, Habit/กิจวัตร, Bill/บิล, and Expense/รายจ่าย. The main cross-screen inconsistency is the later Life/Habits use of นิสัย for the Habit entity.

Finance labels were checked against the page and query logic: monthly income and expenses sum recorded transactions, net balance is income minus expenses, bills are counted by due/paid status, and expenses require a positive amount. No high-confidence advice-like financial copy was found.

Finance budget remaining is clamped at zero when expenses exceed the budget; the current UI does not show the over-budget amount. This is a display/calculation behavior note, not a translation finding.

The targeted production UI scan found no high-confidence hardcoded Thai/English prose in the mapped components/routes. Locale-neutral numeric placeholders, punctuation, icons, and user-entered titles were excluded.
